column1: # Shared @when/@elif/@else/@end conformance corpus. One row per (fixture, os,
# arch): the comma-separated set of TAG_* tokens that must survive
# preprocessing as EXACT tokens ("-" = none); every other TAG_* token in the
# fixture must be gone, and the line count must be unchanged. The last column
# is the expected diagnostic class: "-" = none, "warn" = an unsupported atom
# (seed and pure ambient mode: warning/false; pure receipted target mode:
# error, fail closed). Consumed by BOTH compilers:
# Columns are tab-separated: fixture  os  arch  tags  diag
